versions.changelog: v1.0.6 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Second-round fixes - mostly documentation consistency, since the remaining findings were contradictions in the skill's own docs rather than scanner noise. The cron policy now has a single authoritative statement (the policy table is declared the source of truth, and the workflow step was rewritten to match: report-only by default, unattended writes only with autoWrite set to true plus pre-write backup, a path whitelist and a difference report), with an automated consistency check across all six documents. distill-config.json is now part of the declared write scope, documented in a new write-scope whitelist table listing exactly which paths may be written and when. Both READMEs gained a prominent write warning beside the feature list and usage steps, an explicit trigger contract, and negative examples of what does not activate the skill. Language neutrality: the docs switcher now states that both documents are equivalent and answers follow the user's language, the hero's third line is bilingual, and the config note is bilingual with a language field.

Security review fixes (6 findings). Sensitive data (aig T09): added a pre-write interception section with an explicit skip list - access tokens and API keys, passwords and private keys, cookies and session ids, connection strings, payment and identity data, third-party personal data - a rule to drop the whole item rather than paraphrase it, <REDACTED> placeholders in examples, and a note that the config file must never hold real secrets; the config pattern list grew from 6 to 16. Template neutrality (aig T02): the first-run MEMORY.md template no longer embeds a behavioural instruction; it is marked as a user-owned skeleton and the skill only proposes content instead of injecting standing directives. Activation is narrowed to an explicit memory-distillation request with non-triggers and a pre-write gate that reports without writing when the user is only exploring. Cron mode is report-only by default; autoWrite must be enabled explicitly and, when on, still backs up MEMORY.md to memory/archive/ first, writes only to a whitelist (root MEMORY.md, memory/*.md, archive), and reports differences and skips with a per-run note in the daily log. Also declared allowed-tools and the write scope, added language-optional notes to both templates and SKILL.md, excluded repo-side docs from the bundle, and fixed the hero asset (comments removed, bilingual subtitle, contrast fixed).

xiaoyaoclaw-memory-distill v1.0.2

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, workflow, and documentation remain unchanged from the previous version.

**Minor workflow improvement: Now auto-creates memory/ directory if missing.**

- Automatically creates the memory/ directory as needed, ensuring memory distillation functions even if memory/ is absent.
- No longer requires users to run the workspace initializer just to generate memory/, but continues to recommend it for full workspace setup.
- No functional or behavioral changes beyond this smoother onboarding step.
Initial release: distill conversations into MEMORY.md + daily logs, first-run memory building, semantic classification, dedup, sensitive-info skip
